Getting started

Install Mayday on Android, find someone, and link your computer.

On this page
  • Install on Android
  • Find someone
  • Link Mayday for Windows

Install on Android

  1. Download the Android APK from the Mayday website and open the file.
  2. If Android asks for permission to install apps from the source you opened the file with, grant it and return to the APK.
  3. Open Mayday, choose your country, enter your number, and verify it with the SMS code.

Download Mayday

Find someone

If someone sends you a Mayday profile link, open it and continue in the app. You can also scan their profile QR code in Mayday.

Phone-number search works for verified numbers when the account owner allows people to find them by number. If you get no results, ask for a profile link.

Link Mayday for Windows

  1. Install and open Mayday for Windows. A QR code appears on the computer.
  2. In Mayday on your phone, go to Settings → Devices → Connect a computer.
  3. Scan the QR code, check that the digits match on both screens, and confirm the connection.

Download Mayday for Windows
